newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rupiah tumbles through the 2,500 level.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rupiah tumbles through the 2,500 level.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah tumbled through the 2,500 level against the dollar to 2,502 at 0840 GMT on regional spillover, dealers said.
They said it was anticipated that the rupiah could fall through the 2,500 support level after the London market opened.
"It's not a surprise to us. The rupiah is bound to fall through this level. If not in the morning, then during London time or at latest when the U.S. market opens," one dealer said.
Dealers said some offshore players had been seen trying to push the dollar through the 2,500 level since the morning, but met resistance from a mixture of local and foreign players.
They said forward rates were not rattled much but were trending higher, in line with the weakening rupiah.
One dealer in Singapore said spillover on the rupiah was expected because the Singapore dollar and the Malaysia ringgit came under offshore attack.
"Even the Singapore dollars come under pressure. So you can expect some weakening in the rupiah," the dealer said.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,503/08 at 0900 GMT, with the wider spread suggesting further volatility in the market.
